prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1337; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through the intersection on a green light when a vehicle coming from my left ran its red and struck the side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and the airbags deployed. I hit my head against the window frame and felt dazed, with a ringing in my ears and a headache that has not gone away. A paramedic checked me at the scene, and I was later diagnosed with a concussion. I have given the same account of what happened to the responding officer, the medical staff, and the adjuster, and I have not changed any part of it. I am the named driver on this policy and I was the only person operating the vehicle at the time. I am filing this claim to cover my medical care and the repairs to my car.
